NOTE
**Still not ready — the earlier open questions aren't answered**

New: The author squashed 15 pushes into one commit (+35/-0, down from +56/-0) and says everything is fixed. Missing: The comment doesn't say whether the unrelated "View all users" focus styles were removed, or how the dark-theme focus color and border radius were fixed to match the left-sidebar link. The PR description also still reads as it did before, so there is no new evidence that the precise before/after screenshots match.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; Yogesh-Shivaji365 can keep giving feedback, and no reviewer should be assigned until the author confirms the scope and appearance questions.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the commit history! Please confirm that this PR now only touches the "Invite to organization" link (the "View all users" styles belong in #39540), and update the screenshots so the dark-theme focus ring color and border radius visibly match the left-sidebar link, per the [precise screenshots guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
